captions.caption: A close-up view shows a firefighter in a silver proximity suit and gas mask adjusting the straps.
The firefighter continues to adjust the straps on the side of their gas mask.
With a gloved hand, the firefighter finishes adjusting the gas mask.
The firefighter, wearing a gas mask and hood, looks off to the side.
The firefighter looks forward, their eyes visible through the gas mask's visor.
The camera pulls back slightly, showing more of the firefighter's silver suit.
The focus shifts to a mock aircraft fuselage sitting in water in the background.
The firefighter turns their head slightly as another person's shoulder passes in front of the camera.
The camera view is momentarily obscured by someone moving past.
A firefighter begins to put on a helmet with a large face shield over their gas mask.
The firefighter adjusts the helmet, securing it over the gas mask.
The firefighter pulls down on the straps to tighten the helmet.
A close-up shows the firefighter's gloved hand adjusting the helmet.
A flashlight attached to the side of the helmet becomes visible as it's adjusted.
The firefighter, now fully geared with a helmet and mask, looks to the side.
The firefighter adjusts the helmet one last time.
The camera focuses on the reflective, metallic face shield of the helmet.
The firefighter in full gear looks forward, ready for the training exercise.
The firefighter turns and moves away from the camera.
The camera follows the firefighter as they walk away.
A side profile of a firefighter in a silver suit and full headgear.
A firefighter stands on the right side of the frame as smoke or steam begins to fill the air.
The firefighter is seen from behind, holding a hose nozzle as thick smoke billows.
The smoke becomes denser, partially obscuring the firefighter.
Thick, dark smoke continues to pour into the scene.
The firefighter is almost completely hidden by the dense smoke.
The scene is filled with swirling dark and white smoke.
The smoke continues to billow heavily across the frame.
The view is almost entirely obscured by thick white smoke.
The dense white smoke continues to fill the screen.
The smoke finally clears, revealing a different scene.
A group of firefighters in silver suits stand near a fire truck while being sprayed with water.
A firefighter holds a hose, spraying water over the team in what appears to be a decontamination drill.
The firefighters stand in a line as water from a hose washes over them.
An instructor in a silver jacket and brown pants walks in front of the line of firefighters.
The instructor walks out of frame, revealing the full line of firefighters.
The firefighters in silver suits begin to move and adjust their equipment.
Two firefighters in the foreground pick up a red fire hose.
A firefighter slings the red hose over their shoulder, preparing to move.
The team of firefighters in silver suits prepares their hoses next to a large green fire truck.
The firefighters get into position with their hoses.
A firefighter adjusts the hose on their shoulder while looking forward.
A low-angle, wide shot shows firefighters on a vast, wet airfield.
A firefighter in a silver suit walks towards a mock aircraft fuselage carrying an ignition tool.
The firefighter approaches a puddle of fuel on the tarmac.
The firefighter uses the ignition tool to set the fuel on the ground ablaze.
A line of fire erupts and spreads quickly across the surface of the fuel.
The fire intensifies, creating a large wall of flames on the training ground.
The fire grows rapidly, producing a large plume of thick, black smoke.
The firefighter who ignited the fuel stands back and observes the massive blaze.
The controlled fire burns fiercely, with flames and black smoke filling the scene.
Two firefighters in silver suits watch the large fire from a safe distance.
The raging fire covers a long strip of the airfield training area.
The firefighter who started the fire walks away as the blaze continues.
A wide view shows the large fire and the significant amount of black smoke it is producing.
A close, low-angle shot shows the bright orange flames burning on the surface of the fuel-covered water.
A helicopter is visible flying in the distant sky behind the thick smoke from the fire.
The fire continues to burn with intense, rolling flames.
Flames leap high into the air as dark smoke billows from the controlled burn.
The intense fire continues to rage on the training ground, reflecting in the water.
